onboarding.title: Welcome to KQCMM
onboarding.welcomeBody: This app brings together duas, khatm, fateha khwani, sijrah nama, biographies and the Islamic calendar. Take a few moments for a short tour — it is easy to follow, and you can skip or come back to it any time.
onboarding.readAloud: Read the content like an open book or an e-book — one card after another, in large, clear text.

home-links.title: Start here — the home cards
home-links.body: These cards are your main doorway. Tap Dua to read duas, Khatm-e-Khwajagan for the khatm, Sijrah Nama, Fateha Khwani, biographies and more. Each card opens one section. Large and easy to press.

content-reading.title: Reading a page
content-reading.body: When you open a section, the content appears as a series of cards, in large clear text — like an open book. Scroll down to read each one. At the bottom you will find a counter (+, –) to help you keep count of repeated duas or zikr, and buttons to move forwards and backwards. There is also a quick-jump button (a small book icon) to skip straight to a chosen part.

header-menu.title: The menu button
header-menu.body: Tap this button to open the full menu. It lists every page — including Home, the biographies, Fateha Khwani, Khatm, Roshni, Duas, the Calendar and About. To go Home at any time, choose Home from the menu or tap the house icon at the bottom.

header-settings.title: Settings — make it comfortable for you
header-settings.body: Tap this gear to change how the app looks. You can pick your language, change the theme (colour) to something easy on your eyes, choose a bigger or smaller text size, and change the font. Nothing here can be broken — you can always return and adjust.

hijri-strip.title: The Islamic date strip
hijri-strip.body: This band just below the top shows today’s Hijri date and the Gregorian date, and marks special events. Tap it to open the full Islamic Calendar, where you can browse months and see important dates.

welcome.title: Assalamu Alaikum, and welcome
welcome.body: This app brings together duas, khatm, fateha khwani, sijrah nama, biographies and the Islamic calendar. Take a few moments for a short tour — it is easy to follow, and you can skip or come back to it any time.

choose-fateha.title: Choose Fateha Khwani
choose-fateha.body: Please tap the Fateha Khwani card on the Home page. We will wait for you to choose it.

slide-next.title: The next button — ▶
slide-next.body: See the buttons at the bottom of the page? Press the ▶ button to move to the next card. Go ahead and press it now.

slide-prev.title: The previous button — ◀
slide-prev.body: Well done! Now press the ◀ button to go back one card. It works just like turning a page backwards.

slide-end.title: Jump to the start or the end
slide-end.body: The ⏮ button takes you to the very first card, and the ⏭ button takes you straight to the last card. Press ⏭ now — it is the one with two arrows pointing right.

counter-inc.title: The counter — keep count
counter-inc.body: The plus (+) button counts for you, one press at a time. This is very useful when you repeat a dua or a zikr many times. Press the + button now and watch the number go up.

counter-dec.title: The counter — going down
counter-dec.body: If you press too many times by mistake, press the − (minus) button to go back down. Try pressing the − button now.

counter-reset.title: The counter — start again
counter-reset.body: The ↺ button brings the count back to zero, so you can start counting afresh. Press the ↺ button now.

choose-sijrah.title: Choose Sijrah Nama
choose-sijrah.body: When you return Home, please tap the Sijrah Nama card yourself.

return-home-sijrah.title: Return Home
return-home-sijrah.body: Tap the Home button at the bottom to choose Sijrah Nama next.

choose-roshni.title: Choose Roshni
choose-roshni.body: Please tap the Roshni button in the bottom navigation bar to open it next.

return-home-roshni.title: Return Home
return-home-roshni.body: Tap the Home button at the bottom to choose Roshni next.

choose-dua.title: Choose Duas
choose-dua.body: Please tap the Dua button in the bottom navigation bar to open it next.

return-home-dua.title: Return Home
return-home-dua.body: Tap the Home button at the bottom to choose Duas next.

finish.title: You are ready
finish.body: That is everything. Open any card from Home, or use the menu to explore. If you wish, come back to Settings later and press 'Replay walkthrough' to see this tour again.
